instruction: A rounded vintage camper van with a bulbous nose, tiny round headlamps, and a windup key on its side. Its lithographed tin body is painted cream and mint with faded red pinstripes and printed rivet seams and license plates. Chunky rubber-look wheels and a slightly dented roofline give it charming mid-century tin-toy character.
